title: 2023年12月六级写作：给孩子自由探索的空间
prompt:
续写作文：以下列句子开头写一篇文章："Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence." 可以发表评论、举例或结合个人经历展开。（150-200词）

开头句：Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.
